title: The Little That Becomes Much When You Place It in His Hand
description: In this powerful sermon, Pastor Chris Zehner reveals how God wants to multiply your resources and bring abundance into your life, not just for a season, but for a lifetime. By placing your "little" in God's hands, you can experience a transformation that will change your life forever. Join Pastor Chris as he shares biblical truths and real-life examples to help you tap into God's promises of provision and prosperity.
